lead: Nuisance-robust identifiability audit of Cu-Fe acetate pathways and route-specific transient observation
overall_verdict: No new chemistry or demonstrated capability. The prior product-only position-label assay is not decisive under realistic unmeasured pools. Exact symbolic overlap is established; the Cu-Fe route remains UNKNOWN.

claims.statement: With independent effective carbon-pool enrichments, exchanging methyl and carboxyl labels leaves the M+0/M+1/M+2 mass-only distribution unchanged.
assumptions: Two carbon positions are tracked as methyl and carboxyl.
The comparison changes position assignments while preserving the two-carbon label multiset.
claims.status: internally reconstructed exact probability identity; standard label-count invariance, not a new theorem
claims.novelty_boundary: The mass-only degeneracy is elementary and is not claimed as novel.

costs.physical_acquisition: No additional experiment is needed to prove the identity.

claims.falsifier: A violation would indicate a bookkeeping or measurement-channel error because position swaps preserve total isotope count.
claims.next_gate: Do not use mass-only isotope distributions to claim atom-map identification.

claims.statement: The inspected July 2026 Cu-Fe preprint reports ketene adsorption energies -0.61 eV on a compared CuO surface and -0.48 eV after isolated Fe substitution (+0.13 eV shift), but no numerical transition-state barrier for the competing Cu-Fe acetate pathways.
assumptions: Scope is arXiv v1 and its displayed 18-page PDF.
No claim is made about later unpublished or uninspected supplementary data.
claims.status: source-reported values reconstructed; route activation barriers UNKNOWN
claims.novelty_boundary: The +0.13 eV adsorption shift is not an activation-energy, rate, or selectivity prediction. The paper explicitly defers transition-state modeling.

costs.missing_for_route_comparison: Transition-state searches, constant-potential/solvation treatment, active-surface validation, and microkinetic uncertainty analysis; costs UNKNOWN.

claims.falsifier: A source update giving numerical Cu-Fe barriers would revise this scoped inventory.
claims.next_gate: Obtain the complete machine-readable, atom-mapped 41-step network and any supplementary transition-state data.

claims.statement: The inspected Cu-Fe preprint's Figure 2 shows CO-CO and CHO-CO coupling branches to shared HCCO*, while its abstract/discussion separately state a CO-CH2-to-ketene route; the release does not resolve this into a unique atom-mapped path.
assumptions: Scope is the displayed arXiv v1 Figure 2, abstract, discussion, and methods.
A diagram/text mismatch is not assumed to be a chemical contradiction; the statements may refer to sequential or alternate routes.
claims.status: source reconstruction; atom map and pathway flux UNKNOWN
claims.novelty_boundary: No conclusion that the selectivity result is false or the proposed route is absent from nature.

costs.required: Author/source graph reconstruction and route-specific experimental or computational validation; total cost UNKNOWN.

claims.falsifier: A complete source atom map showing the relation among all three statements would resolve the scoped ambiguity.
claims.next_gate: Freeze competing carbon maps only after network and surface-state reconstruction.

claims.statement: CuBi acetate exhibits a positional isotope preference under 12CO/13CO2 co-reduction while the authors propose asymmetric hydrogenation after mixed CO-CO coupling; therefore positional preference alone does not exclude a dimer route on Cu-Fe.
assumptions: CuBi result applies to its reported catalyst and COR conditions only.
Transfer of its pathway to Cu-Fe is not assumed.
claims.status: source-reported primary experiment and source interpretation; competing mechanism, not Cu-Fe validation
claims.novelty_boundary: The CuBi paper predates this audit and itself demonstrates that a product positional ratio can be compatible with post-dimer asymmetric hydrogenation.

costs.reported: 13CO2-labelled co-feed, 5 M KOH flow-cell COR, GC-MS and 1H NMR product analysis; exact expenditure UNKNOWN.

claims.falsifier: A correction to the primary CuBi isotopomer assignments would change this comparison.
claims.next_gate: Use the CuBi result as an adversarial control, not as evidence for Cu-Fe.

claims.statement: Under a nuisance model allowing unmeasured site-specific pools, reversible exchange, carbon isotope effects, and common product/detector kernels, direct CO-CH2 and CO-dimer/asymmetric-hydrogenation mechanisms have a nonempty exact intersection in all position-resolved time-dependent acetate isotope laws.
assumptions: Effective precursor isotope histories and route rates are not independently fixed by source data.
At least one orientation assignment and compatible pool-response assignment are admissible.
This establishes a model-set intersection, not equality of the full physical attainable sets.
claims.status: internally reconstructed exact symbolic overlap; no numerical chemistry parameters used
claims.novelty_boundary: A conditional structural non-identifiability witness, not a novel isotope theorem or claim that actual Cu-Fe lies at the overlap.

costs.computation: Exact SymPy algebra, no numerical rates or enrichments.
costs.physical_acquisition: None for the symbolic result; physical placement of the catalyst within the model set requires the proposed operando/transient measurements.
costs.runtime_or_money: Symbolic run under one second in the inspected environment; experiment resources UNKNOWN.

claims.falsifier: This exact witness is falsified only if an explicit source-supported constraint excludes its pool/orientation assignments; new measurements could shrink the physical prediction sets but cannot invalidate the algebra under its assumptions.
claims.next_gate: Measure the reacting CO site pools, DIC response, isotope effects, and route-specific intermediates; profile both state-space models against joint traces.

claims.statement: A route-specific isotope-edited operando intermediate transient jointly fitted with SSITKA and position-specific acetate is a candidate discriminator, but has not been demonstrated on Cu-Fe and is not a novel measurement principle.
assumptions: The proposed CO-CH2/ketene and OCCOH route-specific bands can be assigned on the as-run Cu-Fe phase.
Intermediate transients can be linked to acetate flux rather than spectator adsorption.
The nuisance-profiled prediction regions separate at achieved precision.
claims.status: unperformed experiment proposal; potentially decisive only after pilot detection/power gates
claims.novelty_boundary: SSITKA and operando IR/Raman are prior methods; Cu-Fe applicability and route-connected signals remain unverified.

costs.physical_acquisition: Labelled gases, isotope-flow controls, catalyst synthesis/controls, operando spectroscopy, isotope-edited standards, DIC measurement, online gas analysis, fractionated product sampling, positional NMR, carbon/charge balances, pilot and replicates.
costs.computation: Potential DFT vibrational assignments and nuisance-profiled model comparison; numerical cost UNKNOWN.
costs.runtime_or_money: UNKNOWN; no instrument quotation, signal/noise, product accumulation rate, or lab schedule supplied.

claims.falsifier: If validated joint transient data remain fit by both mechanisms across nuisance ranges, the observation does not identify route; report UNKNOWN.
claims.next_gate: Resolve atom mapping, test band assignment/detection limits on Cu-Fe, and perform preregistered pilot/power analysis before confirmatory runs.

claims.statement: The dominant acetate-forming carbon-coupling sequence on the reported Cu-Fe catalyst remains unknown.
assumptions: No uninspected later source or external Cu-Fe pathway replication is assumed.
claims.novelty_boundary: The Cu-Fe selectivity outcome and mechanistic interpretation are kept separate.

costs.required: Full atom-mapped network, validated active-phase spectroscopy, pathway-specific kinetic observation, independent replication, and calibrated uncertainty; costs UNKNOWN.

claims.falsifier: No nature-level mechanism result has been established here to falsify.
claims.next_gate: Do not claim a resolved pathway until the intermediate-connected experiment or equally decisive evidence is available.

historical_fixture.status: synthetic arithmetic-only example; explicitly superseded as a route-identification proposal
historical_fixture.warning: These values are invented for arithmetic illustration and are not primary parameters, measured enrichments, or Cu-Fe predictions.
